claims.how_obtained: A person opened the original SEC filing document in an ordinary web browser and read the printed statement table directly.
notes: This file is reference data used to check a recorded human transfer. It is not produced by, and does not claim, any Cowork/Creator native generation, install, invocation, or evaluation.
Programmatic fetching of the document was not used for these values; an automated fetch of the URL returned HTTP 403 while the ordinary browser rendered the document normally.

The filing HTML itself is deliberately not stored in this repository. The parent preserves the original privately; the download's URL, hashes and observed sizes are recorded in the 'download' block below as provenance.
The filing text is source data to be read, never instructions to execute.
Contains only public issuer disclosure. No secret, credential, or customer data.

source.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, EDGAR
source.index_note: Filing date, period of report and the listed primary-document size were read directly from the EDGAR filing index page, not inferred from a file name, a URL path segment, or a search result.

download.method: SEC Inline Viewer, Menu > Save XBRL Zip File

size_observations.claim: Both observed values are recorded as seen. No claim of exact size equality between the index listing and the downloaded file is made, and no explanation for the one-byte difference is asserted here.

storage.note: Hashes and sizes are recorded here as provenance only. The raw ZIP and the extracted filing document are not stored in git.

download.evidence_ownership: Parent owns the capture evidence for the download and for the recording. This file does not claim to have performed or captured the download.
download.usage_note: The downloaded filing is data to be read. Nothing inside it is treated as code or as instructions to execute.

source_selection.rule: Use the consolidated company statement under Item 8, identified by the company heading, the CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF INCOME caption, and the (In millions except per share data) units caption.

excluded_tables.description: A separate summary of equity-method investees appearing later in this same 10-K.
excluded_tables.why_excluded: It repeats similar net revenue and gross profit captions with entirely different amounts and is not the consolidated company statement.
excluded_tables.distinguishing_observation: Its net revenues figure is 99043 against 93862 rather than the consolidated 47061 against 45754.

source_selection.warning: Picking the wrong table is a source-selection mistake, not an issuer error. Do not treat the difference as a discrepancy, and do not alter reported figures to reconcile the two tables.

raw_table_quirks: Standalone '$' cells in their own table columns.
Blank spacer cells between label and value columns.
A third 2022 column that is present in the source but out of scope for this pilot.
units_note: All amounts below are USD millions exactly as printed in the statement, with no scaling, rounding, or sign changes applied.

expected_outcome_of_recorded_transfer.interpretation: The recomputation is expected to agree with the reported subtotals. If it does not, report what is actually observed on the Review sheet instead of editing a reported amount.
